notes.title: ONE WEEK TO GO! Here's our new Launch Trailer to whet your appetite!
notes.content:
SEVEN DAYS TO GO!
It's all getting very exciting isn't it? Too exciting for us here at Nakama, to be truthful. We can't keep our new Launch Trailer to ourselves, so we're sharing with you a little early....
[previewyoutube="hncZY6lMrwU;full"][/previewyoutube]
 
The Final Push... 
As we approach the final stretch before release, we ask for your support. If you haven't already, please do wishlist Jamboy here on Steam. This helps us MORE THAN YOU'LL EVER KNOW, and gives our small team the best chances of success as we go into the release window. Any shares and signal boosting of our new trailer is also hugely appreciated, and guarantees your our eternal love for all time.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2403600/Jamboy_a_Jellycious_Hero/"][/dynamiclink]


Reminder! Get Your Jamboy Wallpaper! 
We’ve set up a newsletter! And everybody that signs up (as well as getting exclusive Jamboy news and behind the scenes updates) will instantly get an exclusive wallpaper of the new artwork - including resolutions for both desktop and mobile. You can sign up here. And no spam, just jam. We promise. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395068/ba544562bf44e08d0da444be8f91ce23d06b1a95.png"]

Until next time!
